options.outgoingScript: function mapFromDittoProtocolMsg(namespace, name, group, channel, criterion, action, path, dittoHeaders, value, status, extra) { var payload = { success: status < 400, status: status || 200, thingId: namespace + ':' + name, data: value || {} }; if (status >= 400) { payload.error = value; } return Ditto.buildExternalMsg({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, JSON.stringify(payload), null, 'application/json'); }
